_: The absolute power ladder (module 76 §128). `damage` is a TYPICAL LIGHT HIT; heavy attacks land at ~heavyMultiplier of it. Authors write band + position + variants; the compiler interpolates these ranges into fixed numbers. Ranges retuned 2026-08-29 by the balance sim (armour ratings and D5 health were pushing endgame fights past two minutes).
_variantClamp: a variant may not push a field more than this far past its band edge - so 'strong armoured' cannot invent a tier of its own

bands.label: low - an unprepared traveller may survive
standard - a new but prepared character survives
fixed endgame, reachable early, never scaled

diseased.note: carries a disease effect on hit

_poiseNote: Poise/posture was removed (owner veto, round 2): the sandbox has no poise system and this design does not introduce one. Hit reactions stay as they are today - attack id and hit zone - plus the existing guard-break.
_damageNote: Damage bands are CALIBRATED, not eyeballed: they solve for 'how many completely unavoided blows kill the band-appropriate character in typical armour' - 10 at D0, 5 at D1, 4 at D2, 3.5 at D3, 3 at D4/D5 (owner ruling, round 2: getting hit must matter). Absolute best-in-slot armour lands nearer 5-6 by mitigation alone. Re-derive with the calibration in tooling/stats-sim; retune globally with curves.json difficulty.enemyDamageMultiplier.
_hitsToDieTarget: How many completely unavoided blows should kill the band-appropriate character in typical armour. This is the number the damage band was solved for, and the thing to change first if the game feels too forgiving or too brutal. Heavy armour naturally lands a blow or two above it; best-in-slot lands at 5-7.
